pccp-release.title: MFD Impact Assessment
pccp-release.rationale: FDA MFD Guidance §IV requires a standalone Multiple Function Device impact assessment showing how the PP3500's non-device or other-device functions could affect the device function under review; the SAD references the MFD topic but no dedicated MFD Impact Analysis file is present in this batch.

pccp-release.title: Security Risk Management Report
pccp-release.rationale: FDA 2023 §III requires a standalone Security Risk Assessment / Report tying threats to controls and residual risk; the threat-model file is present but a formal SRA report is not in this batch.

pccp-release.title: Post-Market Cybersecurity Plan (§524B)
pccp-release.rationale: §524B requires a documented post-market cyber plan covering monitoring, disclosure, and patching; the vulnerability management plan partially overlaps but a dedicated post-market cyber plan deliverable for the 510(k) cybersecurity section is not separately present.

pccp-release.title: Security Risk Management Plan
pccp-release.rationale: IEC 81001-5-1 §4.2 requires a Security Risk Management Plan (planning artifact) distinct from the threat model and SRA; not present in the cybersecurity batch.

pccp-release.title: Post-Market Problem Resolution
pccp-release.rationale: The current IFU file is a v0.1 placeholder stub (per task ben/023 frontmatter) and does not yet contain the post-market problem-resolution pointers required by IEC 82304-1 §9.2 for the K210345 filing version of labeling.

pccp-release.title: Cybersecurity Management Plan
pccp-release.rationale: FDA 2023 §VII requires a Cybersecurity Management Plan covering the post-market lifecycle; flagged for cross-batch reconciliation with cybersecurity batch.

pccp-release.title: Problem Resolution Process
pccp-release.rationale: IEC 62304 §9.1 problem-resolution procedure not present; gap to be reconciled with software-lifecycle batch.

pccp-release.title: Decommissioning Plan
pccp-release.rationale: IEC 82304-1 §11 expects a Product Lifecycle / Decommissioning Plan covering end-of-support for PP3500 SaMD components; not present.

pccp-release.title: Post-Market Surveillance Plan
pccp-release.rationale: A formal PMS Plan referenced by every catalog obligation in this batch under applies_to is required as submission content per FDA expectations for Class II devices; PMCF study records alone do not constitute the PMS Plan.

pccp-release.title: Security Requirements
pccp-release.rationale: Catalog requires a dedicated Security Requirements specification per IEC 81001-5-1 §5.2; the two files in this batch are general DIS placeholders/design-inputs and do not yet include an itemized security-requirements section discoverable in their frontmatter for the K210345 filing.

pccp-release.title: Benefit-Risk Analysis
pccp-release.rationale: ISO 14971 §7.4 requires a documented benefit-risk analysis when residual risk is judged using benefit considerations; no standalone BRA file in this batch — content may be embedded in the RM Report but a discrete artifact is preferable.

pccp-release.title: Safety-Related Characteristics Checklist
pccp-release.rationale: ISO 14971 §5.3 calls for identification of qualitative safety characteristics; no dedicated checklist file is present.

pccp-release.title: Software Requirements Trace Matrix (IEC 62304)
pccp-release.rationale: No dedicated software-unit-level trace matrix linking SaMD/SiMD software requirements to architecture, units, and software V&V exists in the batch; IEC 62304 §5.1.1 and the FDA June 2023 Premarket Software guidance require this distinct from the system UN→DI trace for the K210345 filing.

pccp-release.title: Hazard / Risk-Control Trace Matrix (ISO 14971)
pccp-release.rationale: The auto-generated trace shows zero risk items parsed and no risk-control-to-DI linkage; ISO 14971:2019 §7.4 and §9 require traceability from each identified hazard through its risk control measure to verification evidence — required for the 510(k) risk file and PCCP risk-impact analysis.

pccp-release.title: PCCP Envelope Scope Trace (Filing Scope Column)
pccp-release.rationale: Per the regulatory strategy, every UN/DI must carry Ct* tags driving a 'Filing Scope' column (In 510(k) / In PCCP envelope / Commercial-only); this scope column is not yet visible in the current trace artifacts and is required for the PCCP modification protocol to be reviewable.

pccp-release.title: Software Test Plan (STP) — IEC 62304
pccp-release.rationale: PP3500 is a SaMD-plus-SiMD pump and the IEC 62304 V&V triplet (STP/STC/STR) is a distinct sign-off from device-level verification; no STP file appears in this V&V batch — needed for K210345 software documentation.

pccp-release.title: Software Test Cases (STC) — IEC 62304
pccp-release.rationale: Per IEC 62304 §5.5/§5.6/§5.7 the executed software test cases are a distinct deliverable from the plan and from device verification — not present.

pccp-release.title: Software Test Results (STR) — IEC 62304
pccp-release.rationale: The executed software test results / system test report under IEC 62304 is a distinct sign-off and a required attachment to the 510(k) software documentation.

qsub-release.title: Q-Sub Cover Letter
qsub-release.rationale: Every Q-Sub package must include a formal Cover Letter identifying the submitter, device, and purpose per FDA Q-Submission Program guidance; no such file exists in the architecture batch and none is identified upstream.

qsub-release.title: Pre-Submission Questions to FDA
qsub-release.rationale: A Pre-Submission must enumerate specific questions the sponsor wants FDA feedback on (e.g., predicate adequacy of PP3000, PCCP envelope acceptability, MFD scoping); this formal piece is required for any Q-Sub package and is not satisfied by the SAD.

qsub-release.title: Q-Sub Meeting Agenda
qsub-release.rationale: If a meeting is requested with FDA as part of the Q-Sub, a proposed agenda with attendees, timing, and discussion topics is a required formal package piece per FDA Q-Submission Program guidance.

qsub-release.title: Q-Sub Cover Letter
qsub-release.rationale: Required for any Q-Sub package per FDA Q-Submission Program guidance; no clinical-batch file satisfies it and it must be authored as a phase-only artifact for QSub.

qsub-release.title: Pre-Submission Specific Questions for FDA
qsub-release.rationale: FDA Q-Sub Program requires explicit, numbered questions to focus the meeting; no file in the clinical batch contains the PP3500 clinical-evidence questions for FDA (e.g., literature-only sufficiency vs. predicate PP3000).

qsub-release.title: Q-Sub Meeting Agenda
qsub-release.rationale: FDA Q-Sub Program guidance requires a proposed agenda for the pre-submission meeting; not present in any clinical-batch file and must be drafted as a phase-only QSub artifact.

qsub-release.title: Q-Sub Cover Letter
qsub-release.rationale: FDA Q-Sub Program guidance requires a Cover Letter identifying the submission type, device, and sponsor for the PP3500 pre-submission package; not present in the labeling batch and must be sourced from a submission-formal artifact.

qsub-release.title: Pre-Submission Questions
qsub-release.rationale: Q-Sub packages must include the specific questions the sponsor wants FDA to answer (e.g., predicate adequacy of PP3000, PCCP envelope scope, criticality carve-out acceptance); no labeling artifact carries this content.

qsub-release.title: Pre-Submission Meeting Agenda
qsub-release.rationale: FDA Q-Sub guidance expects a proposed meeting agenda when an interactive meeting is requested; this is a formal package element not satisfied by any labeling file.

qsub-release.title: Architecture ↔ Design Input Mapping
qsub-release.rationale: Current trace summary reports architecture items with zero forward or reverse trace; without this mapping the QSub package cannot anchor an FDA conversation about how the SaMD / SiMD / hardware split implements the Ct*-tagged DIs.
